item.text:
Created the ESM port under `/output` with local `.mjs` modules only:

- Library modules: [cli.mjs](/output/lib/cli.mjs), [iterutils.mjs](/output/lib/iterutils.mjs), [numbers.mjs](/output/lib/numbers.mjs), [pyrepr.mjs](/output/lib/pyrepr.mjs)
- Entry file: [test7.mjs](/output/test7.mjs)

The implementation matches the observed Python executable for:
- valid output formatting
- `--a value` and `--a=value`
- repeated `--a` using the last value
- `-h` / `--help`
- missing `--a`, missing `--a` value, unknown-argument precedence
- invalid integer failures with Python-style `ValueError` text

Verified with `node /output/test7.mjs --a 1,2,-3,12` and the main CLI edge cases. The only intentional text difference is the program name in help/error output: Node reports `test7.mjs` because that is the invoked file name, while the provided executable reports `test7_executable`.
